events.text: The Wasa Star was sold to the Norwegian operator Larvik Line.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 29 August 1983 , after the various conflicting charter agreements were resolved , the Wasa Star was sold to the Norwegian operator Larvik Line .

events.text: She was renamed MS Peter Wessel.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In March of the same year she was renamed MS Peter Wessel

events.text: She started operating on the Larvik–Frederikshavn route.
events.subject: self
events.quote: started operating on the Larvik–Frederikshavn route
